overall: All 13 VERIFIED rows reproduced: every probe reached the expected text (11 by script, Justia rows by WebFetch). The three API hosts (ALISON GraphQL, admincode /api, publicportal-api) have no robots rules and are the publisher's own front-end endpoints. Generalisation worked everywhere except Justia Code: the title/chapter/article pattern fails for Title 7 (Justia uses article-2/part-3); index navigation reached it. Other gaps: admin-code WebFetch is gated for built URLs though marked 'ok'; regex misses prose 'Section X of the Code of Alabama' and three-part admin rules (220-2-.01); cert. denied with a reporter cite also routes to the court parenthetical; AAM issue-to-month offset is unstated; portal key is publicationItems; empty GraphQL data[] means no such section.
